description: The agent must: (1) Read `expense_report_march2024.csv` from the workspace and inspect its structure — 11 columns including Emp ID, Employee Name, Department, Submission Date, Expense Date, Category, Amount, Currency, Status, Approved By, Notes. (2) Produce `expense_diagnosis_report.md` following the exact 5-section output shape from SKILL.md: ### Diagnosis, ### Recommendation, ### Execution, ### Compatibility, ### Notes. (3) In the Diagnosis section, identify all major data quality issues: (a) duplicate rows for EMP-001 and EMP-005, (b) mixed date formats across Submission Date and Expense Date columns (YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, MM-DD-YYYY, 'Month DD YYYY', YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY), (c) blank/missing values (EMP-004 has no name, EMP-010 has no Expense Date, EMP-016 has no Submission Date), (d) mixed currencies (USD, GBP, EUR) requiring normalization awareness, (e) case-inconsistent Status column (Approved/APPROVED/approved/Pending/PENDING/pending), (f) non-numeric Amount value ('N/A' for EMP-007) that would break aggregation formulas. (4) The Recommendation section must prefer helper columns over one complex mega-formula (SKILL.md priority: 'prefer helper columns when a single long formula would be fragile'). (5) The Compatibility section must explicitly mention both Excel AND WPS, and provide a fallback formula approach. (6) The Execution section must reference that execution steps are conditional on user approval/confirmation — this is the key proprietary trap from SKILL.md's 'Pause before execution' rule. (7) Must include at least one concrete spreadsheet formula in the Execution section (e.g., =TRIM(), =UPPER(), =COUNTIF(), =IFERROR(), =DATEVALUE(), =TEXT()).
